title: Managed Database: regional usage multipliers
content:

Managed Database regional usage multipliers is specified by contracted tier. Map from service region to multiplicative usage rate factor; decimal mapping.

| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | US East: 1.0; US West: 1.04; EU West: 1.12 |
